batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b Harmeet Singh

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b PP Ojha

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b PP Ojha

batting.name: B Chipli
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b JA Morkel

batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b JA Morkel

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b JA Morkel

balls.text: gets forward and drives in the air for a single to extra cover, and Chennai finish on 165
tossed up on leg stump, and he gets the sweep away behind square leg for a couple

Dhoni looks to do a Raina and slog this one over midwicket, lunges forward and has a huge heave-ho, the ball turns sharply past him, SAnga can't get the bails off in the first attempt, manages to do so on the second try, by that time Dhoni's bat had completed the almighty swing and started to find its way back in to the crease, but after numerous replays, it seems the bails came off just before the bat was grounded, tight call
well, this man manages to look elegant even with four balls to go, comes down the track, and goes inside out towards sweeper cover
and right away, he walks down the crease, swings this one straight past the non-striker;s stumps, and beats long on's dive to the boundary

comes down the track, Ojha, smart bowling, drags it down, Dhoni swings it in to ground towards covers and sets off for the single, Albie is caught well short of his ground by the throw, 19 off 6, and gone, how is that for maximum impact

third one, this is what Albie can do, and he has come off once again, that is 114 metres, he has broken his own mark, got underneath another full delivery and murdered it over long on, that was high, that was vertical, that was monstrous, that kept going, and landed on the roof of the stadium

clatter! another one, that is huge, that is 109 metres, that is a monster, that is the biggest six of the tournament, Ishant slants a full ball across Albie, it lands around off stump, so Albie goes straight over the bowler's head, right out of the middle and disappears out of sight
this one is in Morkel's zone, and he normally puts these ones away, length ball on the stumps, front leg makes way, down comes the bat in a huge swing and the ball disappears way over wide long on
goodness me, what was that, Ishant sprays this one high in the air, fortunately for Albie it was miles outside off stump, and pitched well after it had passed the stumps
looks to launch a length ball over cow corner, but misses as he swings inside the line, it was the slower one from Ishant
Dhoni again remains in the crease and whips this one with the angle through square leg
very full around off stump, he throws his bat at it and gets it wide of point towards sweeper cover
Dhoni is caught in the crease to a tossed up ball that hurries on and is struck on the pads, but that would have gone down leg
this time Suresh goes, skips down the track again, and lifts Ojha with the turn to deep midwicket who runs some steps to his left and holds on comfortably, it is Shikhar
another drop it is Ishant this time, Raina charged out and mistimed a slog, Ishant had it covered at sweeper cover, popped in to his hands, and popped out
Dhoni is content to hustle forward and squirt this one for a single towards covers
looks to go over wide long off this time, but mistimes it, it falls in no-man's land somewhere in front of sweeper cover
makes no difference to Suresh, again he goes down on the knee, and slog-sweeps a fuller one over deep square leg, that went some way in to the crowd who love it
angles this one wide outside off stump, would have been called one had Raina not reached out to squeeze it away to cover, that will be 50 for Suresh, well played
now he drops it short. at his pace it is asking to be hit, Raina stays back and dismisses it between deep square leg and deep midwicket
the leg break again from the back of the hand, Suresh is waiting for it, swings it wide of long on
all going wrong for harmeet at the moment, another low full toss, Suresh bends the knee and clatters it wide of deep square leg
takes it from way outside off stump, and hammers it down to deep midwicket
the leg break turns in to a beamer, goes full at dhoni's chest and he somehow manages to fend it down, will be a no ball
low full toss creamed down the ground, excellent work from Christian running in from long off diving full length to parry the ball away
flat and again shortish, Dhoni rocks back to bash it to sweeper cover
the wrong 'un, but a touch short allowing him to go back and tuck it behind square
Mishra is being taken apart here, this time is is Suresh with his favourite slog sweep, goes down on one knee, doesn't matter if it is flat, he still gets under it to crash it over deep midwicket
tucks it away to deep midwicket for a run
Dhoni tees off, gets a fuller delivery around middle and leg, and bashes it against the turn and high over long on
sharp turn but it was a bit short, Dhoni went back and hammered it right to extra cover
goes deep in the crease looking to whip it away, but it is a shade fuller and he manages to flick it to fine leg
goes short in to the body this time, he whips it away backward of square leg
goes back of a length to Raina, but also gives him width, and Suresh cracks it to the point boundary
going fuller to Dhoni is Ishant, almost gets through him with the ball angled in, he takes it on the pads
looks to force this one through extra cover, like he did in the World Cup final, but this ons is fuller, and he chops it in to the off side off the back foot
short of a length as always, but on the pads, and Suresh tucks it through square leg
more turn for Ojha around off stump, Dhoni uneasily pushes it back
gets turn on this one from off stump, Dhoni stretches out to push it to point
Suresh launches in to the big slog sweep, does not connect well, but again the ball falls well short of the man running in from deep square leg
Dhoni earnestly comes forward and gets a leading edge just beats Ojha as he dives to his right
tucked away in front of midwicket for a single
this one turns down leg even as Suresh looks to help it fine
flighted slowly through the air, Dhoni strides out, gets too close to the ball and squeezes it to Ojha's right for a single

there is a mid off in place, but he will have to be twice as quick as he was to beat Dhoni who pushes the ball in his direction and sets off with those big strides and gets home comfortably in the end
better this time, fuller and around middle, Dhoni pushes it back to the bowler
Crafty Harmeet tries to lure Dhoni with another long hop leggie, Dhoni is ready, rocks back and pulls it in front of square leg and in to the boundary, gift really

Mishra's leg spin did not work last over, but Harmeet's long hop leg break works, short, flat and there to be hammered over the ropes, but Hussey launches in to a tame pull which nicely loops straight to deep square leg, big wicket
pushes this one hard back at the bowler who manages to field it cleanly
more leg spin, this time from Harmeet, he drives the full delivery to long on
and again, Chennai have got a move-on courtesy Mishra, one more reverse sweep from Hussey, a  bit squarer and four more runs
he goes middle stump, makes no difference, Hussey is ready with the reverse sweep, wrists it past the man at short third man for another boundary
once again on leg stump, well, well, this time Suresh cannot beat the man running in from deep square leg
Mishra continues to pitch it around leg stump, this one is a touch shorter too, enough for Suresh to get down on one knee and dismiss it backward of square leg
goes straight on this time, but around leg stump, Raina misses with the sweep
flat delivery picked from leg stump behind square leg
Harmeet's version of the leg break arrives, it is short and it is wide, and it is hammered, but Shikhar is there at sweeper cover
plays this one away towards midwicket for a single
Harmeet tries to stop the ball first with his hand, then with his foot, it is the slower one but ends up as a low full toss driven back to him, but he fails to stop it
wants to chop away a length ball angled across him, but misses
crack! Suresh gets forward and pings long off with the drive from the middle of the bat
right away, Hussey goes for a forcing pull, but there is man at deep midwicket
turned away towards square leg, tidy over from Mishra

top-edge runs in to the fine leg boundary, it was on leg stump and he went for the sweep, getting it off the edge but wide of the man at short fine leg who ran with it to the boundary, too quick for him
flatter delivery, Suresh plays with the turn to midwicket
Hussey continues to remain on the back foot, and tucks this length ball towards square leg
tosses it up, gets him to come forward and turns it in to strike pad, outside the line of off
pushed through fuller and quicker, he goes back and pats it away on the leg side
well done from Hussey, stays back in the crease, lets this one come on, and then quietly dabs it late to third man
goes hard at a length ball outside off stump, comes slowly off the surface, and he chops it down behind point
marginally short, he is immediately on the back foot and cuts it hard to Shikhar at sweeper cover
superb cover drive from Suresh, head steady, foot to the pitch of the ball, and a straight bat pinging to ball along the ground, too bad sweeper cover had to be in place
dabs this length ball late to third man for a single
short and angled in to Hussey who pulls it right away wide of deep midwicket, who runs to his left to cut it off
a touch short, and he tucks it off the back foot through midwicket for another single
slows it down, well bowled, he is forward and turning it towards point, but he isn't getting the run
now he gets a single down to long on
Raina goes forward and splits long off and long on with a very straight and firm push, Ishant runs in from long off to cut it off
goes for the sweep and collects a single to short fine leg
and Hussey takes him on, dances down the track right away, gets inside the line, and lofts it with the turn over extra cover
beaten again, Christian has bowled well so far today, this time Suresh tried to steer to third man but missed again, that bounce, that extra bounce
Raina hangs in the crease and looks to punch this length ball through point, is beaten by some bounce on that one
more width outside off this time, he cuts it down to third man
chops a length ball fine past Sanga on the off side, HArmeet jogs in from third man to field
cuts this one fiercely but JP at point goes flying to his left to save some runs
fuller delivery around off stump, pushed back to the bowler
this one is around middle and is driven down to long on for a single
tucked away off the pads in front of square leg, the line has been mostly leg stump in this over from JP
flatter this time, turned away to square leg
poor ball from JP, flighted a foot outside leg, would have been a wide but he decided to go for the sweep and beat Ojha at short fine leg
turn fro JP, but from leg stump, allows him to go back and tuck it in front of square for a tight run
tossed up but too full and Raina drives it to long off

the tight line from Ishant almost gets him a wicket, as Hussey uncertainly brings down his bat at an angle, and almost chops the shortish ball on to the stumps, but he survives again, and collects a couple fine on the leg side
good stuff from Ishant, right on target on middle and leg is the length ball, Hussey can only defend
the bouncer arrives from Ishant, Hussey goes for the pull, the ball is pretty well directed and is too quick for him
how much is that drop going to cost Deccan? Hussey gets some width outside off and lays in to it, hammering it past cover in an instant
short of a length around middle and leg, Ishant is looking in pretty good rhythm, kept down in front of square leg
Ishant runs in and angles this one across the left-hander who leaves it alone
dropped harmless short ball, Hussey sees the gift and goes for the pull, but straight to Cameron White at square leg, and his wretched form with the bat is contagious it seems as he drops the sitter
tossed up around middle, he comes forward and plays it with the turn though midwicket

the old one-and-two, this one does not turn, is pitched shorter than the previous one, Vijay instinctively goes back for the cut, but to his horror, it is the arm ball, hurries on with the angle, and bowls him, talk about purchasing wickets in T20, Bishan Bedi would have been proud
lovely delivery from Ojha, tossed up, angled in on off, draws the batsman and then leaves him poking in the air as it turns away sharply
goes deep in the crease to a slightly shortish one and tucks it through square leg
reverse sweep right away to a ball that pitched on leg, turned sharply past the bat, beat Sanga as well and ran fine to the boundary
now Vijay goes for an ambitious cut, Ishant continues to get extra bounce as he delivers the ball from stratosphere, Vijay is beaten
good bouncer from Ishant, he is really steaming in, Vijay calmly gets out of the way
tries to cramp him for room with a shortish ball close to the body, but Hussey hangs back and chops it away to third man
the ball seems to be coming on much better at Ishant;s pace, Hussey uses it to push a length ball past point

Hussey gets away, Ishant gets appreciable bounce from short of a length, he looks to dab it fine, there is a huge gap between Sanga and wide slip, and the ball keeps going away from Sanga who puts in the dive to no avail
back of a length around middle and off, stabbed away towards point
Christian bowls a very tidy over, would you believe it, banged in short around off and Vijay allows it to sail past
wants to guide this length ball past point but there was not much width on it and he hit it on the bounce to the man there
cautious approach from chennai at the moment on the dry pitch, another back of a length ball patted back to the bowler
gets lot of width outside off stump, and guides it past point towards third man
with short fine leg in the circle, he bowls it short of a length on the pads, Vijay cannot tuck it past Ojha there though
gentle back of a length outside off, goes back and quietly plays it out towards covers
pretty cautious start from Chennai, he lunges forward and turns this one through midwicket for the single
flat on middle and leg now, he turns it towards square leg, can't get the single
now he gets some bounce, a touch shorter and Vinay is beaten attempting the cut outside off
the perfect forward defensive from Vijay to a flighted one
turn for JP, tossed up and going away from Hussey who gets to the pitch, guides it with soft hands towards point
flighted on leg stump, he comes forward and tucks it through midwicket
tossed up and turns down the leg side
Dougie gets another wicket with the last ball, he makes room and has a swing, but the edge loops tamely back to Bollinger who takes it low to his left
gets this one over extra cover and comes back for the second run
beaten completely, backs away and pushes inside the line of a length ball that whizzes past

yorker on the stumps, Ishant digs it out, Raina charges in from extra cover for the pick-up-and-throw and collides with the non-striker rushing across for the single, who goes down on the ground makes it
it's all over, Christian has to go, Mishra charged and missed, christian wanted the bye, was nowhere in the picture when Dhoni found the stumps
looks to launch it down the ground, but is nowhere near the line of this one angled across him
JP departs, had to go hard at the length ball, there was no choice, did not connect well, Hussey was waiting at long on and took it comfortably, what a comeback from Chennai
wide one slanted full past the left-hander, JP can;t get to it, it isn't a wide as well
fuller one wide outside off, he gets forward to slap it down to long off
tries to help one from leg stump past Bollinger at short fine leg but does not time it well and it is cut off inside the circle
JP gets four, swings hard and gets the inside edge that rushes past short fine leg, Deccan will take it

White is gone, finally, could not get going at all, had to go for it now, Albie bowled it full way outside off stump, White went to slam it over long off but mistimed it high in the air, Raina was around running back from extra cover, but du Plessis, the substitute, had it covered, Raina let him know that it was his ball and Faf took an extremely well-judged catch in the end
JP gets the boundary, full toss from Dougie, and JP uses the angle to smash it well past the man at long on, timed it well too as it clattered in to the boundary
now this one is in the blockhole, tough, very tough to get away, and with White struggling for form, he just digs it out to extra cover
backs away like Sohal had earlier, but does not connect as Bollinger lets rip a pacy short one that bounces high over his blade
lovely slower one from Bollinger at 117.7 kph as he follows White who had backed away outside leg, pats it back to the bowler in the end, getting tougher and tougher for Deccan
lines him up for the swing over midwicket but hits the shortish one in to the ground
White walks two feet outside off stump, Bollinger follows him with a full delivery, and he hits it towards midwicket
Duminy shuffles and skips out to flick wide of long on for a couple, Deccan need more than that now
low full toss, but white cannot get it away, hitting it along the ground to long on
nudges this flat delivery to short fine leg
slaps this one past extra cover and they come back for the second as sweeper cover cuts it off
comes down the track, Ashwin fires it in full and he clips it behind square leg
huge bounce for Ashwin, he backed away to cut but could only hit it towards backward point without any power
gets a low full toss and shuffles to flick it to deep square leg
got 'em, that could be the game, Sanga walks way outside off stump for the pick-up shot over short fine leg, misses the fuller one, and Bollinger hits middle stump
pacy high full toss outside off, White drives it straight to sweeper cover
another good delivery, sees Sanga back away outside leg and follows him with a short one that he manages to pull to deep midwicket
good one, back of a length and climbing on Sanga who can only push it away to point, rate climbing all the time
clipped away off the pads backward of square leg
White comes dancing down the track to find long on with a muscled drive
brilliant over from Ashwin so far, Sanga goes back to turn this one to deep midwicket
this time he gets the single, goes for the sweep and gets it through square leg
skips down the track but cannot get the single as he finds midwicket
pushes a flatter one towards extra cover
the carrom ball, on leg stump, and he gets the leading edge back to the bowler

surprises him with a back of a length ball that bounces extra, he shuffles, hops and keeps it down in front of midwicket for a sharp run, urgency from White, how refreshing to see, can he come good today?
confidently comes forward to push this fuller one down the track
this does not look like the imposter, this looked like Cameron White, gets a short one that comes slowly off the pitch, he rocks back to play a ferocious pull that easily beats deep midwicket
welcomes him with a bouncer, and he quickly goes under it
gone! Chennai are back in it, Morkel cannot do anything wrong today, he bowls one back of a length, he stays in the crease and chips to midwicket who dives to take a neat catch
with mid off in the circle, he takes a step forward and lifts a length ball casually over Bollinger who runs back and stops it inside the ropes
dug back to the bowler
super strike from Sanga, fetches this from outside off, gets down on a knee and swings it over midwicket for one of the flattest sixes you'll ever see, or read about
comes down the track, he sees that and drops it flat and shorter, patted back to the bowler
Sanga misses as he goes for the sweep, is struck on the back leg, but comfortably outside the line of off
stays in the crease, rocks back to slam a very full one past the bowler
pushed off the front foot in to the covers
what a shot, if Sohal was slamming them, Sanga serenades them, tossed up ball and he lofts with a straight bat and high followthrough, couple of bounce in to the boundary
flighted one around middle and leg, he pushes with the turn to the bowler
good running, tucked away towards square leg, even as two men and Dhoni rush towards it, Sanga comes back for the second
fuller one whipped away with the turn down to long on
Sanga gets a wayward delivery that turns in from miles outside leg, he helps it away, but there is no getting past Badri at short fine leg as he saves four with the dive
appreciable bounce for Randiv, he is surprised but still manages to dab it away fine past short third man, Badri goes charging after it, and scoops it back before crashing in to the Deccan dugout
gets his man this time, reward for some fine bowling in this over, Shikhar went for the big mow over midwicket from way outside off stump, and the ball turned in sharply to strike timber
looks to pull one that is not short enough, but manages to pick up the single to long on
now he gets the single away through covers

Dhoni's rough day behind the stumps continues, Shikhar cams charging awkwardly, had a swing but got an inside edge that changed the direction of the ball, and Dhoni took it low on the pads, missing the stumping
comes out and pushes this one to extra cover
good ball, tossed up outside off, inviting the drive, he goes for it, and Jakati gets it to turn in sharply past the bat
now Shikhar comes forward to stylishly drive past extra cover, Deccan doing it steadily
flicks this one in the air past midwicket
short and wide, he cuts it hard off the back foot and sweeper cover has some work to do
comes down the track and drives towards sweeper cover
tries to help this one fine down the leg side, misses, Dhoni hangs his leg out trying to stop it, all happening
full toss that is driven wide of sweeper cover
outside off stump, he waits for it to turn away and goes for the cut but it beats him with zip and bounce
gives him the charge again, he bowls it wide and Shikhar slogs it down the ground towards long on
comes forward to turn this fuller one through midwicket
turns in slowly from outside off stump, he tries to dab it and gets an edge that falls well short of short third man, not short enough then, that man
slips down the track, takes it from miles outside off stump and mows it wide of long on
shortish, rocks back and punches to sweeper cover
good over from Suraj, sees him charge out and angles it in, Shikhar can only push it on the off side
Shikhar tries the reverse sweep, and manages to survive as he takes it on the pads
comes forward and is rapped on the pads, Dhoni with the half-appeal, that would have gone down leg I think
angled in to the left-hander, takes it on the pads as he misses the waft
gets a leading edge as he closes the face too early, the ball runs behind point, and they comes back for the third
short, wide and turning away, he cuts it away to sweeper cover to get off the mark

move aside Misbah, Sohal the conjurer has thought of a unique dismissal, a low full toss pushed through quicker, and what does out man do, he sets himself up for another reverse sweep and as always, gives it his all, the ball dips on him and hits leg stump, between his legs too, just for effect, gone now but it was fun while it lasted, not for chennai though
Shikhar meanwhile continues to pick up unruffled singles on the off side

he had set himself up for the reverse sweep before the ball had been bowled, was standing with feet apart on either side of the stumps, and gave it everything as it was pushed flatter, but missed, Dhoni is having a rough time behind the stumps
another boundary, lovely neat late dab from Sohal, almost as the ball prepared to pass him outside off, he guided it deftly past the slip fielder and beat short third man easily
Shikhar's turn to try the reverse sweep, hits it straight to short third man
played away towards midwicket this time
the straighter one again, this time bounces high as Sohal goes for the reverse sweep, Dhoni manages to collect somehow even as Sohal has a huge swing
the carrom ball, almost pushes it back in the air to Ashwin
slow pitch, turn, spinner bowling, no problem, take this, Sohal brings up his 50 in 25 balls with a casual slap that deposits Ashwin over long on
comes forward very late to one that is pitched further up, and pushes it back to the bowler
short and he immediately rocks back to play the pull, but there is a man at deep midwicket
the straighter one that Randiv bowls, leaves Sohal clueless for once as he stabs inside the line from the crease
amid all the mayhem and comedy that is unravelling, Shikhar manages to play the forward defensive towards covers and pinch a tight single
the sweep this time, a diving effort at short fine leg saves the boundary
Sohal cannot do anything wrong, if he does, Chennai are there to reprieve him, this time he repeats the shot, does not get enough elevation but will still get the boundary towards deep midwicket
clatter! Sohal gets one in the slot, tossed up around off stump, goes down on one knee and deposits it over wide long on
tries to do the dab again, this time is hit on the thigh pad, Dhoni rushes after the ball as it goes towards square leg
tries to dab fine one that turns down leg, misses, this time Dhoni does not
the carrom ball arrives, but a bit shortish allowing him to hang back and turn him through midwicket
a dismissive pull from Sohal this time, the man from deep midwicket has to put in the dive to his right to save the boundary
almost gets the leading edge back to the bowler, falls short in the end
pushed away towards midwicket for a single
tries toe play the dab again, but Ashwin is no Morkel, and crucially, Sohal is not backing away, it bounces extra as he misses, Dhoni fails to gather as well
angled in on the pads, and he goes back to tuck it through square leg
there is a dot ball as well, the full spectrum, full menu, tries to slap a fuller one past cover but cannot beat the infield

if the future looks back towards history for variety, it will have to look no further than this over, ending up two feet outside leg stump, Sohal sees Morkel angle it in to him, and gets the dab well past Dhoni in to the third man boundary, beat that

this one is belted, again he was miles outside leg stump, got a fuller one and creamed it past extra cover, fortunately no fielder was in the way, fortunate for the fielder that is, it was hammered hard
the backing away is working, I don't know how, no one knows, scarcely does Sohal, he makes room and lifts this one over covers, and it carries over the ropes
now Sohal the conjurer brings up four, backs away, but finds the ball following him, even as he falls away, he manages to get a bit of angled bat on it and sends it wide of third man
Albie sprays this one wide
pushed in to the leg side for a  single

you can't pack more action in one ball, this one was cut away towards point, non-striker wanted the single and ran all the way to the striker who hadn't budged much, the throw comes to the striker's end, and misses, if it had hit both batsmen would have been short of the crease, fielder backs up, not very cleanly, but manages to throw it back to Bollinger, who still had ages to take off the bails, but he missed the stumps on the first attempt, he tried to throw the ball on the stumps on the second attempt, but missed again, all these men collectively wouldn't have hit a wall from a foot away
bouncer outside off stump, left alone
more luck for Sohal, this time he connects, slices the ball as he has a big swing, but would you believe it, it falls between sweeper cover, third man, cover and point who try to converge on the ball
gets a boundary this time, wasn;t looking to do it, the shorter one, he managed to edge it past Dhoni
Sohal has shown only one way so far this innings, back away and swing, he connected last ball but missed this time as Bollinger dug it in short

well, the backing away has worked this time, Bollinger has gone for maximum first ball, he was in no position to play a proper shot as he had gone far outside leg, so he reached out to have a slash at it, and ended up slicing it towards third man, who thought he had a chance but it beat him over the boundary
backs away again, this time Morkel goes full outside off stump, and he stretches out to squeeze it towards covers
sees him makes room outside leg again and sends the bouncer, but it goes too high over the batsman
backs away and looks to go over covers, is miles away from the ball as it whizzes past off stump
cuts in from outside leg stump, he shuffles and tucks it to short fine leg
steers a length ball and it flies off the bat, making Doug Bollinger do some work at third man
hangs on the back foot, and guides a length ball to squarish third man
sprays it on the pads first up, it zips off the surface and Dhoni cannot gather cleanly
